title: OpenAI Confirms Acquisition of Pierre Computer to Expand Codex Into Software Infrastructure
summary:
The AI research firm confirmed on Tuesday it has entered a definitive agreement to buy Pierre Computer, a developer tools startup that specializes in Git-based code storage. The purchase aims to transition OpenAI's Codex programming tool from a coding assistant into a platform where software teams can collaborate from initial conceptualization to final deployment, specifically tailoring the infrastructure for use by AI agents. The deal remains subject to standard closing conditions, including regulatory approvals.

The acquisition allows OpenAI to incorporate Pierre’s storage and review tools into Codex, building on the "Trees and Diffs" libraries already used by the app for file browsing. While financial terms for the 10 person startup were not disclosed, Pierre's open-source projects will remain public. The move follows the launch of Pando, a Git backend that reduced median code-push latency by about 80%, as OpenAI builds a more comprehensive alternative to Microsoft's GitHub.

SITUATION EXPLAINED: OpenAI is buying Pierre, a startup that set out to build a better GitHub, to power Codex.

• Pierre makes Code Storage, Git hosting built for software that writes code, plus the open-source libraries Trees and Diffs
• Trees and Diffs already run file browsing and code review inside the Codex app
• Code Storage's features will move into Codex, and Pierre's open-source projects will stay open
• OpenAI has also built Pando, an internal source control system for agents working in parallel, which reportedly cut deployment latency by about 80%
• Pierre had about 10 employees, and OpenAI didn't disclose the price
• Jacob Thornton co-created Bootstrap at Twitter in 2011

OpenAI is coming for GitHub! 🚀

@OpenAI is acquiring @pierrecomputer, a developer tools startup specializing in Git-based code storage infrastructure. Its technology is already being used in Codex, and OpenAI plans to integrate Pierre's Code Storage directly into the platform.

This is a significant move. OpenAI is expanding Codex beyond AI-powered coding into the infrastructure needed to store and manage code produced by AI agents at scale.

With Codex, the recently unveiled Pando Git backend, and now Pierre Computer, the pieces of a serious GitHub competitor are coming together. Exciting times for software development!
